title: Majority coefficient and the middle layer
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer and let $T$ be a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,2m-1\\}$. The Fourier coefficient of majority on the $(2m+1)$-dimensional Boolean cube at the set consisting of the last coordinate together with the coordinates of $T$ embedded among the first $2m$ coordinates equals the Fourier coefficient at $T$ of the indicator of the middle layer of the $2m$-dimensional cube, namely the inputs with exactly $m$ coordinates equal to $+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite set of coordinates in $\\{0,\\ldots,2m-1\\}$
